renderEvidence.scopeCaveat: The enclosing workflow failure is unrelated to Decor 3-4 and is not relabeled PASS; it came from staged desks-2/desks-3/desks-4 image-decode failures. This review relies only on the clean exact Decor 3-4 scoped card/detail evidence.

reviews.name: Arcade Mini
reviews.reason: Actual exact-hash card/detail pixels read unmistakably as a compact physical arcade cabinet rather than a flat icon: cabinet side planes, bezel, control deck, joystick/buttons, trim, fasteners, feet and grounded contact/shadow create convincing object thickness and construction. Navy/teal/gold star-and-orbit treatment remains coherent with Adventure Club while preserving the exact Arcade Mini identity; the silhouette and controls survive small-card scale. Materials/light have enough separation for a starter-tier object without looking placeholder-flat. No exact duplicate was reported in the staged replacement set and visual comparison against the other current Decor cards shows a distinct cabinet silhouette and function.

reviews.name: Plush Stack
reviews.reason: Actual exact-hash card/detail pixels clearly read as a freestanding stacked plush decor object: the flower-like base cushion, rounded central plush, star/cloud top elements, stitched seams, pile/fuzz texture, overlap and floor contact provide convincing soft-material depth. The pink/lilac/cream cloud-star palette is strongly Cloud Pop, the richer stacked form appropriately steps above the Tier-1 starters without becoming overbusy, and the broad silhouette remains immediately legible at card size. It is visually/functionally distinct from the current Decor set and the staged replacement report contains no exact-duplicate group.
